isolation_fix.defect: Referee._brief() sent the full scene card to every entity process and EntityScope.READABLE exposed card, so a unit could read a competitor's task deadline from static configuration without receiving any message.
isolation_fix.change: gongyu/private_card.py splits public map configuration from the unit's private task sheet; EntityScope.card now serves a redacted brief in strict topologies; Referee._brief(actor) builds a per-unit brief from world.local_assignments[actor]. The referee keeps the original card for validation and metrics.
isolation_fix.public_parameters: World.view() shared_blue_plan.air_inspection_deadline_ms is the task-book's published inspection window; it carries no peer task status, progress or private deadline. Decision deadlines come from view.own_tasks.
isolation_fix.tests: tests/test_private_task_card.py (6 cases): visible deadlines == own task set for every entity, public configuration unchanged, per-process briefs differ, controller programs unchanged.
